Name: The Backrooms Wallpaper (AT)
Author: bunniemoth
Description:
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A wallpaper inspired by [i]The Backrooms[/i] for your [/color][color=#1155cc]house[/color][color=#D4D4D8].[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Buy the paint bucket from Robin, point your cursor at the nearest farmhouse wall with the bucket equipped, and feel free to use the keywords, "The Backrooms" to bring up the selections. There are three baseboard flavours to choose from, but the wallpaper remains the same. [/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Please make sure you're using the most recent copy of Alternative Textures.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Thanks[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]To the person on reddit who thought this would be a great idea -- I thought so too. This one's for you, bub. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Please Don't[/b][/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Please don't distribute this mod on any other site or feed it to an AI to dissect. It's literally the most baby of baby mods. It took more time to write the Nexus description than to throw a few pixels together and write a few lines of code. I implore you: please keep it human.[/size][/color]
